2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
3.

The present Writ Petition has been filed by the Petitioner with the following prayer:
"Under such circumstance it is therefore prayed hat your lordships would be graciously pleased to admit this Writ application , call for records and after hearing the parties may be pleased to issue a writ/writs, order/orders , direction/directions in the nature of certiorari quashing the letter issued by the Opp. Party No.2 ,dt.
02.08.2025 under Annexure-2.

And further may issue a Writ of mandamus directing the Opp. Party No.2 to de-freeze his account vide account no.10233809943 in the name of Vrindaban Enterprises ,
forthwith preferably within a stipulated period as this Hon'ble Court deems fit and proper.

And may pass any such other order/orders, direction/directions which this Hon'ble Vrindaban Group Of Companies vs The Chief Financial Officer on 23 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169770127/
1 court may deem lit and proper."
4. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the Petitioner's company known as Vrindaban Enterprises has undertaken various business model comprising procurement and supply of organic farms fresh products, civil supply contracts, transportation services, digital sales, spices, flour, fresh,
preserved fruits, vegetables and other related food products.

sentences.text: The said above works have been undertaken through IDFC Bank, Janpath Branch, Bhubaneswar.

5. Learned counsel for the Petitioner further contends that the Branch Manager, IDFC Bank,
Bhubaneswar without any reason has freezed the Petitioner's account bearing A/c. No.
10233809943 for which the Petitioner could not operate its account.
He further submits that the Petitioner has made a representation before the Bank to defreeze its account.

In response, the Bank has sent a reply to the Petitioner through email stating that its account has been freezed as a precautionary measure to ensure its safety and certain transactions observed in its account did not appear to align with the profile information.
Hence, the Petitioner is constrained to approach this Court.

6. In such view of the matter and considering the submission made by the learned counsel for the parties, this Court directs the Petitioner to approach the Bank with an explanation to defreeze its account within 15 days from today.
In such event, the Bank shall do well by following the required procedures as per the guideline of the Reserve Bank of India.
7. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
